source.title: How our clients close the month in 3 days instead of 9

core_insight: A slow month-end close is a pile of small daily habits, so four habits and no software cut it from 9 days to 3.
wide_reason: The user asked for a thread, a Telegram post, a carousel and a video script from this one article.

atoms.text: 14 small-shop clients went from a 9-day close to a 3-day close without hiring.
atoms.evidence: Today the same 14 clients close in 3 working days. Nobody hired anyone.

atoms.text: Four habits: daily 10-minute reconciliation, one receipts inbox, a fixed 3-day calendar, a one-page report plus a 15-minute call.
atoms.evidence: We changed four habits, and none of them is software.

atoms.text: The 10-minute daily bank match, with a one-line note for anything that does not match.
atoms.evidence: Our clients now open the bank feed every morning and match yesterday's lines.

atoms.text: Close on a calendar even when something is missing; a late small correction is cheaper than a late report.
atoms.evidence: A late correction of a small amount is cheaper than a late report.

atoms.text: One receipts inbox took missing receipts from about 30 a month to under 5 by month two.
atoms.evidence: missing receipts drop from about 30 a month to under 5

atoms.text: Two clients still have a cash problem; they just see it 6 days earlier, and that is the point.
atoms.evidence: Two of the 14 clients still have a cash problem; they just see it 6 days earlier.
